correctness.rationale: The nonunits form the characteristic radical V, and the coefficient field is fixed by unital K-algebra automorphisms. Every invertible linear transformation of V extends by the identity on K because V²=0. A common witness for v and c+v forces the same radical output, and a witness for v and av forces scalar equivariance. A witness on an independent pair preserves independence, so distinct projective lines map to distinct lines and, by finiteness, to all lines. Conversely take any invertible linear map for two zero radicals, extend one prescribed nonzero image for a dependent nonzero pair, or extend the two independent input/output lists to bases. These witnesses apply to the original pairs with arbitrary scalar parts. Representatives identify the group with line permutations and independent scalings, yielding (q-1)^N N!, including q=2 and n=1. For q>2 and n≥2, scaling just one line cannot be linear: for nonzero v on the line and u off it, both u and u+v are fixed and linearity would fix v. For q=2,n≥3, a transposition fixes 2^n-3 nonzero vectors, more than a proper fixed subspace permits; for q=2,n=2 every permutation of the three nonzero vectors is in GL_2(2). An independent finite check tried every permutation of nonzero vectors against precomputed ordered-pair witness orbits, rather than generating only predicted maps. The two-local/global counts were (2,2), (6,6), (384,48), (5040,168) at (q,n)=(3,1),(2,2),(3,2),(2,3).
residual_risks: The bounded enumeration used prime fields only; extension fields are covered by the basis extension proof, not by enumeration.

originality.rationale: The published Resultary record e9aacb2e3a4f is a distinct indexed record with direct, complete mathematical coverage. Set its locality parameter to two: same multiplication, all finite fields and all n≥1, arbitrary rather than assumed linear or bijective maps, and the same K-algebra witnesses. Its proof gives the scalar-equivariant projective-line permutation description, and its finding gives exactly the wreath product, count, ordinary subgroup and rigidity cases. It additionally proves three-local rigidity, which is absent from the frozen claim. There is no supported distinct scientific claim remaining in the frozen two-local statement against that comparison. This is a finding of present equivalent coverage, not a finding that the indexed record preceded the frozen work, or that one was derived from the other. The Xu thesis is relevant to historical priority, but the incomplete access to it is not a reason for this verdict.
residual_risks: Full Xu thesis text was not accessible through the identified lawful repository route. Historical priority and independent derivation are unresolved.
The decisive comparison is a verified exact broader indexed finding, not merely a similar title, absent paper or known ordinary GL group.

value.rationale: As a mathematical classification, this characterizes all pair-local maps of a natural algebra family, not just their number. It resolves exactly when pairwise interpolation forces linearity, gives nonlinear witnesses elsewhere and exhibits the sharp distinction between projective directions and full linear relations. That structural local-to-global question has mathematical use independently of the adverse distinctness assessment; it does not establish additional content over the matched result.
residual_risks: No claim about non-split rings, higher radical powers or field-moving automorphisms.
